menu:4042840:1.source_cn: 这日子什么时候是个头啊……

menu:4042850:1.text: Ugh... Why is it taking so long to heal?

say:1:1223637001:1.text: Recently, we've been at loggerheads with <style="stress">Renata and her men</style>. Some of us are injured but have yet to receive treatment.
say:1:1223637001:1.source_cn: 最近大伙儿和<style=stress>雷纳塔那帮人<...
say:1:1223637001:1.male: Recently, we've been at loggerheads with <style="stress">Renata and her men</style>. Some of us are injured but have yet to receive treatment.
say:1:1223637001:1.female: Recently, we've been at loggerheads with <style="stress">Renata and her men</style>. Some of us are injured but have yet to receive treatment.

say:2:1223637002:1.text: I heard you could make potions... Could you spare some for us?
say:2:1223637002:1.source_cn: 听说您会炼伤药……可以施舍点给我们吗？
say:2:1223637002:1.male: I heard you could make potions... Could you spare some for us?
say:2:1223637002:1.female: I heard you could make potions... Could you spare some for us?

say:1:1223638001:1.text: Why not see a doctor? Well, we usually just put up with it and tough it out.
say:1:1223638001:1.source_cn: 为什么不去治病？没这习惯，忍忍就好了。
say:1:1223638001:1.male: Why not see a doctor? Well, we usually just put up with it and tough it out.
say:1:1223638001:1.female: Why not see a doctor? Well, we usually just put up with it and tough it out.

say:1:1223639001:1.text: Why don't you see a doctor?
say:1:1223639001:1.male: Why don't you see a doctor?
say:1:1223639001:1.female: Why don't you see a doctor?

say:2:1223639002:1.text: I'd rather die and let my body rot here than have any more dealings with those stinky Carmine Whispers!
say:2:1223639002:1.source_cn: 老子就是在这里疼死、病死，在这发烂发臭，也绝对不会再和...
say:2:1223639002:1.male: I'd rather die and let my body rot here than have any more dealings with those stinky Carmine Whispers!
say:2:1223639002:1.female: I'd rather die and let my body rot here than have any more dealings with those stinky Carmine Whispers!

say:1:1223640001:1.text: *Sigh*... I can't do anything with my leg injured.
say:1:1223640001:1.source_cn: 唉……我这腿，现在干啥都不方便。
say:1:1223640001:1.male: *Sigh*... I can't do anything with my leg injured.
say:1:1223640001:1.female: *Sigh*... I can't do anything with my leg injured.

say:2:1223640002:1.text: The herbs can only be found on the outskirts. I can't even reach there by crawling!
say:2:1223640002:1.source_cn: 药材在城外那么远的地方，我爬都爬不过去！
say:2:1223640002:1.male: The herbs can only be found on the outskirts. I can't even reach there by crawling!
say:2:1223640002:1.female: The herbs can only be found on the outskirts. I can't even reach there by crawling!

say:0:1223641001:0.text: I remember there are some here...
say:0:1223641001:0.source_cn: 我记得这里有些草药可以用……
say:0:1223641001:0.male: I remember there are some here...
say:0:1223641001:0.female: I remember there are some here...

say:0:1223642001:0.text: These should be enough. Let's head back to prepare the potion.
say:0:1223642001:0.source_cn: 这些够用了，回去炼药吧。
say:0:1223642001:0.male: These should be enough. Let's head back to prepare the potion.
say:0:1223642001:0.female: These should be enough. Let's head back to prepare the potion.

say:2:1223643002:0.text: Tell me if you need anything else.
say:2:1223643002:0.source_cn: 要是缺什么，随时喊我，我给您去找来。
say:2:1223643002:0.male: Tell me if you need anything else.
say:2:1223643002:0.female: Tell me if you need anything else.

document:3:86:0.text: A potion that can alleviate mild ailments. The brew combines the essence of <style="stress">featherbugs, bittergreen twigs, and small wingleaves</style>.
document:3:86:0.source_cn: 能快速治愈轻症疾病的药水，闻起来略带甜味，一般由<style="stress">羽虫，苦青树枝，小翼叶</style>熬制而成。
document:3:86:0.male: A potion that can alleviate mild ailments. The brew combines the essence of <style="stress">featherbugs, bittergreen twigs, and small wingleaves</style>.
document:3:86:0.female: A potion that can alleviate mild ailments. The brew combines the essence of <style="stress">featherbugs, bittergreen twigs, and small wingleaves</style>.

say:1:1223644001:1.text: *Sigh* My peers just don't care enough about their health.
say:1:1223644001:1.source_cn: 唉，我这帮弟兄，都是些不在意自己的命的粗人。
say:1:1223644001:1.male: *Sigh* My peers just don't care enough about their health.
say:1:1223644001:1.female: *Sigh* My peers just don't care enough about their health.

say:2:1223644002:1.text: We needed that attitude when we lived on the edge before.
say:2:1223644002:1.source_cn: 以前大家刀口舔血，不在意命不要紧。
say:2:1223644002:1.male: We needed that attitude when we lived on the edge before.
say:2:1223644002:1.female: We needed that attitude when we lived on the edge before.

say:3:1223644003:1.text: But now, being healthy is everything if we want to make money! We'll never ever forget your favor!
say:3:1223644003:1.source_cn: 现在过上了正常生活，好的身体才是赚钱的基础啊！太感谢了...
say:3:1223644003:1.male: But now, being healthy is everything if we want to make money! We'll never ever forget your favor!
say:3:1223644003:1.female: But now, being healthy is everything if we want to make money! We'll never ever forget your favor!
